title: YouTube Summarizer with Transcript Chunking and Whisper Fallback
description:
A Python command line tool that summarizes a YouTube video from its transcript and returns a short summary, key points and chapter timestamps.

  • Transcript: captions via youtube-transcript-api; if a video has none, the audio is downloaded with yt-dlp and transcribed locally with faster-whisper.
  • Chunking: each transcript line keeps its [mm:ss] timestamp, so the model can cite where a point is made.
  • Summarization: map-reduce over chunks with the OpenAI Python SDK, either against OpenAI or a local model through Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API.
prompts:
Below are timestamped notes from a video titled "{title}". Write in {language}:
1. A summary of at most {words} words.
2. 5 to 7 key points as bullet points.
3. A list of chapters as "mm:ss - topic", using only timestamps that appear in the notes.
Do not add facts that are not in the notes.
implementationSteps: Extract the 11-character video id from watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed and live URLs
Fetch captions in the preferred languages with youtube-transcript-api
If there are no captions and the Whisper fallback is enabled, download the audio with yt-dlp and transcribe it with faster-whisper (CPU, int8, VAD filter)
Prefix every transcript line with its [mm:ss] timestamp and group lines into chunks of about 12,000 characters
Summarize each chunk into timestamped notes with a chat model (skipped when the video fits into one chunk)
Merge the notes into a final summary, key points and chapter list, with the output language configurable
Configure the model and endpoint via OPENAI_MODEL and OPENAI_BASE_URL to switch between OpenAI and Ollama
Test offline with fake caption API, fake Whisper model and fake chat client
performance:
Expectations, not measurements:

  • A video with captions needs one caption request plus one chat request per 12,000 characters of transcript (about 15 to 20 minutes of speech) and one final request.
  • The Whisper fallback runs locally; on CPU with the small model expect roughly real time or slower.
  • Summary quality depends on the model and on caption quality; there is no accuracy figure.
userExperience: The user passes a video URL and gets a plain-text summary, bullet-point key points and a chapter list such as 04:12 - Pricing, so they can jump to the parts they need. Caption languages and the summary language can be chosen. The tool says whether the transcript came from captions or from Whisper.
